editorial: You know that feeling when you walk into a place and something just feels off? That is exactly the vibe this movie nails from the very first scene. A young woman named Tess shows up at her Airbnb late at night for a job interview, only to find a strange man already staying there because of a double booking. Against her better judgment, she stays the night, and that is when things start getting weird. The house has hidden rooms and dark tunnels underneath, and what lives down there is something you will not see coming. The movie keeps you guessing the whole time, shifting from creepy tension to full-blown horror without warning. The acting is strong across the board, especially from the lead, who makes you feel every ounce of her fear. The pacing is tight and never drags, and the twists hit hard. Some viewers might find the second half a bit wild compared to the slow burn beginning, but that is part of the fun. If you love horror that surprises you, this one is a must.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Tess and AJ escape the tunnels, but the Mother, a feral woman who has been living underground, chases them. AJ tries to sacrifice Tess to save himself, but Tess fights back and kills him. The Mother, who had shown a strange attachment to Tess, is finally killed when Tess shoots her. Tess escapes the neighborhood, badly injured but alive, while AJ dies in the street. The movie ends with Tess driving away, leaving the horror behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror movies with big twists and creepy settings.
